{{Top|leg}}
An '''analytical computer'''<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> or '''analysis computer''' was a type of [[Computer/Legends|computer]]. It could sort information in either a holographic or flatscreen format.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref> The unit was commonly installed in [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]] such as [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droids]].<ref name="GG3" /> Analytical computers could also be connected to [[infrared motion sensor]]s such as the [[NiteSite infrared motion sensor|NiteSite]], allowing it to track up to fifty targets at once.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
